resources.string: Plug the adapter into the vehicle\'s OBD port and pair it in your phone\'s Bluetooth settings. Then choose it here - once only.
Could not connect to %1$s. Check it is plugged in and the ignition is on, then choose it again.
Connected. Saarthi is reading this vehicle\'s engine directly.
It will reconnect on its own each time you start the vehicle. There is nothing to switch off.
The adapter is connected, but the engine is not answering yet. Turn the ignition on and Saarthi will start reading it.
This phone cannot connect to a vehicle adapter.
Humsafar needs permission to connect to nearby devices before it can talk to the adapter.
Permission was refused. Allow Nearby devices for Humsafar in your phone\'s settings.
Turn Bluetooth on to connect to the adapter.
Pair the adapter in your phone\'s Bluetooth settings first, then come back and look again.
